files.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE polished high-resolution full-body Arin T-pose reference image, not a contact sheet. Input image 1 is the exact body/armor/pose edit target. Input image 2 is the approved Arin head identity reference. Reproduce the first image faithfully while reconstructing fine details, and use the appropriate head from image 2 to correct/refine the face and hair. Preserve the ivory/silver armor, gold trim, dark navy undersuit and tabard, cyan inset accents, sun emblem, armor plate geometry, gloves, boots, athletic proportions and all equipment worn as clothing. No redesign. Improve skin pores, facial contours, eyes, brows, fine hair strands, clean armor engravings, cloth weave and material definition without oversharpening. All four intended outputs must represent the same man, hairstyle, outfit and scale. Pose: neutral standing T-pose, both arms straight sideways at shoulder height, elbows straight, wrists neutral, hands empty and flat, straight legs, feet slightly apart. Orthographic camera with no perspective distortion. Complete character centered on a square canvas, head to boots and every fingertip fully inside the frame, approximately 93 percent canvas height and sufficient transparent margin around the silhouette. Retain normal head-to-body proportions. Neutral expression, level head. Clean true transparent alpha background, including between limbs. Remove ALL colored edge contamination, red/yellow/white halos and stray opaque pixels. No floor, no shadows or cast shadow, no glow halos, no weapons, shield or scabbard, no text, label, border, logo, watermark, backdrop or checkerboard drawn into the pixels. Flat soft even illumination; clear readable skin and materials. Render at exactly 4096 x 4096 pixels if supported, with the highest available true detail. Output transparent PNG.
VIEW: Straight-on FRONT. Use the TOP-LEFT frontal face in the approved head contact sheet as the facial identity authority: same facial geometry, blue-gray eyes, brows, nose, mouth, jaw, light skin, and swept brown hair. His chest sun emblem faces the camera squarely; shoulders and hands remain symmetric at equal height. Show one front-view character only.
